title: Capital Markets Manager (m/f/d)
description:
𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻𝘆

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Many management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds, yet they struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren’t built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so our clients can launch and run ETFs at scale, helping broaden the access to the market beyond a small group of dominant, US-based providers.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

You will own end-to-end responsibility for the ETFs we run: smooth product launches, day-to-day execution and oversight, as well as continuous platform evolution in collaboration with our product team. This is a strongly hands-on role combining investment expertise, market microstructure understanding, operational excellence and cross-functional execution.

You will gain 𝘥𝘦𝘦𝘱 𝘦𝘹𝘱𝘰𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘵𝘰 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘧𝘶𝘭𝘭 𝘌𝘛𝘍 𝘷𝘢𝘭𝘶𝘦 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘪𝘯, from investment implementation and market mechanics to operational and technology execution. You will have the opportunity to gradually expand your scope into platform building, process scaling, new strategic projects and service development.

Capital Markets

  • Own end-to-end ETF delivery across capital markets, portfolio replication and platform operations

  • Implement and continuously improve replication models; execute index rebalances and support advisory mandates

  • Own ETF quality monitoring (tracking error/difference, liquidity/spreads, premiums/discounts, order books), run root-cause analyses and implement corrective actions

  • Manage creation/redemptions and associated cash flows; oversee daily ETF operations from a portfolio perspective

  • Support larger secondary market transactions, produce/interpret trade reporting and support ETF launches

Portfolio Management

  • Take investment ownership for assigned ETFs, actively optimizing portfolio construction, risk and execution to enhance tracking and liquidity

  • Execute portfolio replication and rebalancing

  • Run daily validation and reconciliation of key data outputs (pricing, holdings and reference data)

Clients and Ecosystem

  • Join client demos and workshops as our capital markets expert

  • Represent NaroIQ at industry events, roundtables and conferences together with our Growth team

  • Support our Growth and Clients teams on client-specific questions

Working with Product

  • Raise requirements from daily operations and give business sign-off on what Product delivers

  • Use and stress-test the AI-driven workflows we build for ETF operations, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

title: Marketing - First Hire (m/f/d), German Speaking
description:
About The Company

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Yet many capital management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds - but struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren't built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so ManCos can launch and run ETFs at scale and compete effectively, helping broaden access to the market beyond dominant, US-based providers.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

The Role and What Makes It Special

You own the two functions that decide how the outside world experiences NaroIQ: How we are perceived in the market, and who we manage to attract to build it. Marketing and Employer Branding sit together in one role at NaroIQ because the same narrative - sharp, technical, high quality - has to land with senior executives and journalists as well as with the engineers, operators and commercial talent we want to hire next.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will not manage a team of specialists who do the work - you'll do the work: drafting the LinkedIn post, creating our brand strategy, building relationships with journalists, organizing events, designing an employer brand. And you'll build the systems that let NaroIQ scale this without losing sharpness.

There is no marketing playbook to inherit and nobody above you in the function. You set the priorities, decide what not to do, and carry the call. That takes unusual self-drive - the kind where nobody has to ask you for a status update, and where an unclear brief is something you resolve rather than escalate.

You report to the CEO (Chris) and work in tight loops with Growth, Product and the leadership team. Over time, you have the opportunity to grow the function around you.

Tasks

What You'll Do

PR & Events

  • Run PR campaigns end-to-end, directly and with external PR partners, to build durable credibility and secure consistent placements in tier-1 outlets (Handelsblatt, Bloomberg, FT) and the FinTech and asset-management publications that matter
  • Build and maintain a working network of journalists and editors; develop narratives that sharpen NaroIQ's positioning
  • Plan and coordinate events and speaking slots (e.g. Money20/20, FinTech and asset-management conferences, exclusive industry roundtables)

Content & Brand

  • Build a scalable content and thought-leadership engine that actively supports sales enablement and pipeline progression
  • Grow NaroIQ's organic LinkedIn presence at the company and founder level. A steady cadence of substantive posts, not noise.
  • Build and maintain a consistent brand identity across every surface: website, pitch deck, one-pagers, careers page, sales collateral
  • Create a brand that sticks with our audience: You decide how we are perceived in the market and what the NaroIQ storyline should look like

Demand Generation & Sales Alignment

  • Develop the materials that prepare and accelerate enterprise conversations: one-pagers, decks, whitepapers, case studies
  • Build and run inbound growth motions: SEO, AI search optimization, and targeted growth experiments
  • Close the loop with Sales: instrument what's working, kill what isn't, feed campaign learnings back into product and positioning

Employer Branding

  • Build NaroIQ's employer brand into a real asset: a careers narrative that pulls senior talent in, a candidate experience that earns referrals
  • Position NaroIQ as one of the most attractive places to work in European FinTech; through content, events, founder presence, and glimpses into the lived experience of the team

Requirements

What We're Looking For

(You don't need to know it all - but you should be ready to dive in, learn fast, and take initiative.)

  • Experience in B2B marketing: Ideally in financial services or at an AI / enterprise startup
  • You can create a brand, not just run one: you've built positioning and narrative for a product or category, ideally while the product was still moving
  • Creative and strong at storytelling: You can draft an explanatory case study, a press pitch that lands, and a job description that pulls. Without slipping into FinTech buzzwords
  • Extroverted and a strong communicator: You build real relationships with journalists, candidates and event coordinators
  • Existing PR network or demonstrable track record in media work is a big plus
  • Data-driven: You think in KPIs and processes, and use them to make the work sharper
  • Experimental: You actively try new channels and formats, like AI search, new social formats, distribution plays
  • You treat candidates as an audience: you can write a role description that makes people apply, shape how NaroIQ shows up to talent, and equip hiring managers with a story worth telling
  • A taste-led approach to brand: you can hold a consistent visual and verbal system across surfaces and push back on output that breaks it
  • Structured and genuinely self-directed: you're comfortable operating with ambiguity, high ownership and no cover in a small, fast-moving team
  • Fluent in English and German, written and spoken

Nice to have: existing relationships with FinTech or asset-management journalists; experience building a careers brand from scratch; familiarity with growth tooling (SEO, attribution, growth-hacking stacks).

Why NaroIQ

We're building something ambitious - and we believe the only way to do that is with a team that's low-ego, high-impact, and genuinely excited about what they're doing.

Here's what we care about:

🔑 High Ownership
We trust you to take full responsibility for your work. That means freedom and also being the person others rely on when things get real.

🚫 No Bullshit, No Ego
We're too small for politics, posturing or competing agendas. We care about doing the right thing, not being right.

🧘‍♂️ Flexibility
Exceptional work doesn't require relocation or fixed office hours. Have dinner with your family. Get that dog. Move to the Alps. We're remote-first and trust people to manage their own time.

🧳 Sometimes We Leave the House
We do make time for real-life moments, like quarterly offsites or in-person team sessions, to solve stuff together or just hang out.

🦸🏻‍♀️ Hire for Spikes
We don't expect you to be good at everything. We care about your superpower. We're building a team of nerds who are world-class in wildly different areas.

🛠 Default to Rethink
We don't accept "that's just how it is." We dig deep, think from scratch and always believe there's a better way. First Principles isn't a buzzword for us.

💅🏼 Give Yourself a Little Treat
We offer benefits via hrmony, so you can spend up to €50/month on the little things that bring you joy: Urban Sports, DAZN, Mediamarkt, Thalia, whatever suits you.

🤓 Your Learning Curve is Our Investment

WaschMal ist ein moderner Dienstleister für professionelle Wäschereilösungen und Textilmanagement. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, ihre Berufsbekleidung und betrieblichen Textilien effizient, hygienisch und wirtschaftlich zu verwalten.

Unser Leistungsspektrum umfasst die Bereitstellung, Pflege, Reinigung, Reparatur und den Austausch von Berufsbekleidung sowie die individuelle Betreuung unserer Kunden durch ein leistungsstarkes Netzwerk aus Wäschereien, Herstellern und Servicepartnern.

Durch intelligente Servicekonzepte helfen wir unseren Kunden, Prozesse zu vereinfachen, Kosten zu reduzieren und höchste Qualitäts- und Hygienestandards sicherzustellen. Dabei stehen Kundennähe, Zuverlässigkeit und nachhaltige Partnerschaften im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns.

Als stark wachsendes Unternehmen setzen wir auf innovative Lösungen, persönliche Betreuung und den konsequenten Ausbau unseres Partnernetzwerks. Unser Ziel ist es, für unsere Kunden der bevorzugte Ansprechpartner für moderne Wäschereidienstleistungen und professionelles Textilmanagement zu sein.

Aufgaben

  • Vertragsimplementierung: Du übernimmst nach Vertragsabschluss die zentrale Verantwortung für die Implementierung neuer Kundenprojekte und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem Vertrieb zusammen.

  • Projektmanagement: Du koordinierst alle notwendigen Schritte und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte strukturiert und erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

  • Partnerkoordination: Du organisierst und koordinierst unsere externen Waschpartner und stellst sicher, dass alle benötigten Dienstleistungen und Produkte verfügbar sind

  • Projektverfolgung: Du behältst den Überblick über zahlreiche parallel laufende Projekte, erkennst Handlungsbedarf und sorgst für eine konsequente Nachverfolgung.

  • Reklamationsmanagement: Du kümmerst dich eigenständig um Reklamationen beim Onboarding, koordinierst Lösungen und führst proaktiv Feedbackgespräche, um Probleme frühzeitig zu erkennen.

  • CRM-Dokumentation: Du dokumentierst relevante Informationen, Gesprächsinhalte und Projektfortschritte in unserem CRM-System und stellst eine zuverlässige Nachverfolgung sicher.

Qualifikation

  • Idealerweise hast du eine kaufmännische Ausbildung, ein Studium oder bereits erste Berufserfahrung im After Sales, Projektmanagement oder Vertrieb. Auch Quereinsteiger*innen sind willkommen.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich.

  • Du besitzt Durchsetzungsvermögen und scheust dich nicht davor, Dinge aktiv anzustoßen und konsequent nachzuverfolgen.

  • Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent und trittst gegenüber Kunden und Geschäftspartnern souverän auf.

  • Du hast Organisationstalent und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Projekten den Überblick.

  • Du denkst lösungsorientiert und hast Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Der sichere Umgang mit MS Office ist für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Du bringst die Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Vor-Ort-Terminen bei Kunden oder Partnern mit.

Benefits

  • Eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle in einem wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum hybriden Arbeiten.

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen.

  • Ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet mit direktem Einfluss auf unsere Kundenbeziehungen.

  • Ein motiviertes Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur.

  • Eine langfristige Perspektive mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

title: Projektleiter Montage (m/w/d)
description:
Kälte-, Klima- und Lüftungstechnik · Projektabwicklung · Baustellenkoordination · Kalkulation

Vollzeit | Standort Erkrath | Baustellen- und Projekttermine nach Bedarf

Du willst Projekte nicht nur verwalten, sondern dafür sorgen, dass sie auf der Baustelle funktionieren?

Dann übernimm bei uns Verantwortung von der Besichtigung und Kalkulation über die Planung und Bestellung bis zur Begleitung der Montage. Du hältst die Fäden zusammen, packst Probleme an und findest Lösungen, statt auf andere zu warten.

Wer wir sind

Kältetechnik Ollbrink ist ein familiengeführtes Mehrgenerationen-Handwerksunternehmen. Von unseren Standorten in Bochum und Erkrath realisieren und betreuen wir Lösungen rund um Kälte-, Klima- und Lüftungstechnik für Kunden aus Einzelhandel, Industrie und Mineralölsektor. Als Teil eines starken Unternehmensverbunds verbinden wir gewachsene Erfahrung mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und neuen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Warum diese Position?

Für unseren Standort Erkrath suchen wir keinen klassischen Bereichsleiter und auch keinen reinen Verkäufer. Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Praktiker, der Montageprojekte aktiv vorbereitet, organisiert und bis zum Abschluss begleitet. Du arbeitest selbstständig, gibst den Monteuren eine klare Richtung und sorgst dafür, dass Material, Termine, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit zusammenpassen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Besichtigung und technische Bewertung von Baustellen sowie Abstimmung der Anforderungen mit Kunden und Projektbeteiligten

  • Erstellung, Kalkulation und Nachverfolgung von Angeboten sowie Bearbeitung passender Ausschreibungen

  • Planung und Vorbereitung der Montageprojekte einschließlich Personal-, Termin-, Material- und Bestellplanung

  • Koordination, praktische Anleitung und Überwachung der eingesetzten Monteure und Nachunternehmer

  • Begleitung der Baustellen, Teilnahme an Baubesprechungen sowie Abstimmung mit Kunden, Planern und anderen Gewerken

  • Kontrolle von Projektfortschritt, Terminen, Kosten, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit

  • Klärung technischer und organisatorischer Probleme und Entwicklung umsetzbarer Lösungen, bei Bedarf unter Einbindung geeigneter externer Fachpartner

  • Dokumentation, Nachtragsmanagement und Vorbereitung einer sauberen Projektübergabe bzw. Abrechnung

  • Aktives Beobachten der Projektauslastung: Wenn Folgeprojekte fehlen, bringst Du Ideen ein, stößt Vertriebsaktivitäten rechtzeitig an und holst Dir bei Bedarf Unterstützung, statt abzuwarten

  • Mitarbeit an praxistauglichen Verbesserungen unserer Abläufe am Standort Erkrath

Was Du mitbringen solltest

  • Eine technische Ausbildung im Bereich Kälte-, Klima-, Lüftungs-, Anlagen- oder Versorgungstechnik; eine Weiterbildung zum Meister oder Techniker ist von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend entscheidend

  • Erfahrung in der praktischen Abwicklung von Montage-, Bau- oder Anlagenprojekten

  • Technisches Verständnis, kaufmännisches Grundgefühl und Sicherheit im Umgang mit Angeboten, Materialbestellungen und Projektkosten

  • Die Fähigkeit, Monteure klar anzuleiten, Arbeiten zu kontrollieren und auf der Baustelle verbindlich aufzutreten

  • Eine selbstständige, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und die Bereitschaft, Themen konsequent bis zum Abschluss zu verfolgen

  • Kommunikationsstärke im Kontakt mit Kunden, Lieferanten, Nachunternehmern und anderen Gewerken

  • Ein gutes Gespür für neue Projekte und die Bereitschaft, vertriebliche Impulse zu setzen, ohne dass Du ein klassischer Vertriebsprofi sein musst

  • Führerschein Klasse B sowie Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen, insbesondere für Baustellenbesichtigungen, Baubesprechungen und Projekttermine

Was Dich bei uns erwartet

  • Unbefristete Perspektive

Ein langfristig angelegtes Arbeitsverhältnis in einem familiengeführten Unternehmen.

  • Dienstwagen

Ein Dienstwagen für Deine projektbezogenen Termine und Baustellenbesuche, auch zur privaten Nutzung nach individueller Vereinbarung.

  • Eigenverantwortung

Du organisierst Deine Projekte mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direkter Abstimmung.

  • Moderne Arbeitsmittel

Eine angemessene technische und digitale Ausstattung für Deine Projektarbeit.

  • Weiterentwicklung

Fachliche Weiterbildungen und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten passend zu Deiner Aufgabe.

  • Starker Verbund

Du profitierst von den Strukturen und Benefits unseres Unternehmensverbunds.

  • Leistungsbezogene Prämien

Jährliche Bonusauszahlung durch den Verbund

  • Zusätzliche Leistungen

300 EUR Gesundheitsbonus pro Jahr sowie Zuschüsse zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und zu vermögenswirksamen Leistungen (VL).

  • Gesundheit und Mobilität

Fahrradleasing und Angebote des Gesundheitsprogramms CareHuman ergänzen unser Leistungspaket.

  • Abwechslungsreiche Technik

Projekte für Kunden aus Einzelhandel, Industrie und Mineralölsektor sorgen für unterschiedliche technische Anforderungen.

  • Finanzielle Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und Bezuschussung von vermögenswirksamen Leistungen

  • Gemeinsame Teamevents

Ganz offen

Diese Position ist nichts für jemanden, der Projekte nur vom Schreibtisch aus begleitet oder bei Schwierigkeiten auf eine Entscheidung von anderen wartet. Baustellen laufen nicht immer nach Plan. Deshalb brauchen wir jemanden, der sich ein Bild vor Ort macht, Prioritäten setzt, mit den Beteiligten spricht und eine tragfähige Lösung organisiert. Gleichzeitig erwarten wir, dass Du die Auslastung im Blick behältst und frühzeitig aktiv wirst, wenn neue Projekte fehlen. title: Lead Designer / Design System Owner (f/x/m) in Tech & Data Team
description:
Our design system is the shared foundation behind the experiences millions of musicians use on thomann.de. It provides consistent components and guidelines for our product teams so they can build faster and focus on what makes each experience unique.

The Design System Team sits within our Product Division, alongside Product Design and Product Research, and brings together a Design System Architect and a group of frontend engineers who turn design decisions into robust, reusable code. We treat the design system as a product in its own right, with its own users, roadmap and priorities.

  • Tjark, Tobias & Heiko are our Frontend Engineers, building and improving the components our shop is made of and making sure every team can use them with ease.

  • Juliane designs the components that bring our shop to life as our Design System Architect, owns our Figma and accessibility libraries and helps new designers find their way.

  • And that’s where you come in: As our Product Owner, you help us decide what matters most, keep close contact with the many teams who rely on our Design System and roll up your sleeves as a designer to shape our components hands-on.

We work remote, distributed, together: Whether fully remote within Germany or on-site in our offices in Berlin & Erlangen - always as a team, always customer-oriented and data-driven.



Here’s what you’ll be doing

  • Own and maintain the design system roadmap, documentation and backlog, aligned with the needs of consuming product teams and with the division's process while following scrum events and existing formats in the team.

  • Run intake and triage: collect requests from designers, engineers and product owners, make prioritization decisions, communicate them transparently and track adoption.

  • Represent the design system in cross-team planning, and represent consuming teams' needs inside the design system team.

  • Design and improve components end to end like states, variants, responsive behaviour, accessibility, edge cases.

  • Maintain the quality bar for anything entering the shared library in Figma.

  • Work closely with the Design System Architect to make sure design intent and component architecture match.

What you should bring to the table

  • Experience owning a product or platform backlog, including saying no to stakeholders and explaining why.

  • Hands-on product design skill: you can design a component to production quality yourself, not only review someone else's.

  • Advanced Figma skills, including component and variant modelling in a shared library.

  • Solid understanding of design systems: tokens, component APIs, theming, accessibility requirements.

  • Enough technical fluency to have a substantive conversation with frontend engineers about implementation constraints.

  • Strong written communication. Much of this role is documentation, release notes and rationale.

What we have to offer

  • Flexible working hours and location, with the option to go into the office (fully-remote possible)

  • 13th salary in November

  • Further training opportunities with clear development paths for your career

  • Thomann.de employee discount

  • Personal work equipment according to your wishes and regarding your role

  • Regular team events

  • English or German language courses

  • 1:1 sessions with an external coach, for professional development

  • Urban Sports Club discount

  • and more! Check out our Handbook

We value inclusion and diversity

title: Product Designer (m/f/x)
description:
UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world’s leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group.

We are looking for a Product Designer (m/f/x) to join our Design Team in Berlin. You will be the design partner for one of our product teams, working alongside a Product Manager and engineers to take work from an early idea through to something people use. You will own your projects, hold a high quality bar on complex, data-rich interfaces, and work inside a design system you help keep healthy.
You will enjoy this role if you want real ownership of a product area without carrying a whole platform, and if you like going deep into a genuinely complex domain. Our team is complementary, so your work is visible and the feedback loop is short.

What you will do:

  • Take design work from an early idea through to delivery, proposing solutions to blockers rather than only reporting them.

  • Be the reliable design partner for your product team: the person your PM and engineers come to first.

  • Design for complexity: dense data tables, long-running processes, and workflows where the edge cases matter as much as the main path.

  • Look for evidence before you design: talk to users, read what support and sales already know, look at how the product is actually used, and run tests on your own work.

  • Push to understand the problem before designing a solution, and say so when a brief arrives already shaped as one.

  • Scope your own features, break them into pieces, be roughly right about how long they will take, and flag delays early with a plan B rather than a warning.

  • Contribute to our design system, as everyone on our team does: propose and build components, not only use them.

  • Share your work cross-functionally, take feedback, and iterate; notice improvements inside your area and act on them, instead of waiting to be asked.


Here is a good summary of what we are looking for:

  • Experience delivering product design work end-to-end inside a cross-functional team.

  • Solid interaction (IxD) and visual/UI design skills, with the ability to make complex data and workflows understandable.

  • Strong Figma skills, and a working understanding of how a design system is actually built: how a component is structured, how it behaves, and the rules it has to respect. You will be a contributor to ours, not only a user of it.

  • Experience using research and product evidence to make design decisions: usability tests, customer conversations, support tickets, product data. We are not looking for one particular method.

  • Comfortable telling the difference between what we know and what we are assuming, and willing to say which is which.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress when the picture is still incomplete, and to adjust when what you learn changes the direction.

  • Able to scope your own work and communicate honestly about time, collaborative, feedback-driven, and proactive about the problems you can see.

  • Fluent in English and based in Berlin with hybrid work capability.

Bonus points if you bring:

  • Experience designing geospatial, enterprise, or data-heavy B2B products.

  • Background in UX research, data visualization, or complex workflow design.

  • Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design.

  • Experience with interactive prototyping.

  • Awareness of current AI tools and emerging opportunities in UX processes, with an understanding of how AI can enhance user outcomes without adding unnecessary complexity.

Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice:

  • Let’s disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective

  • Let’s stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year

  • Let’s win as a team: We’re an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment

  • Let’s be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, an educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few

  • Let’s enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year

  • Let’s think outside of the box: There are challenges and enough space for creativity and taking ownership

Does this sound like a good next step into your geospatial career? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English.

Our culture is one of belonging, where everyone feels welcome and where differences are celebrated. We seek to recruit the best talent regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background and/or belief—and strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We also value more than the skills and experiences outlined in this job description. Even if you think you only fill 60% of the requirements for this role - we would still like to consider your application.

title: Branch Support Manager - Europe
description:
About Rain for Rent International

Rain for Rent International provides innovative tank systems for liquid management applications. As an internationally operating rental and service company, expertise centers on rental, logistics, and services around the tank, focusing on the core competencies of renting storage tanks, containment systems, pumps, and filtration units.

Your role

We are looking for a hands-on Branch Support Manager ( m/f/d ) to help our teams across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France get the best from our business systems, processes and support functions.

This is not a traditional IT Manager position.

It is a highly business-facing role combining business systems, operational processes, user support, training, continuous improvement and team leadership. You will work closely with our branches and Shared Services teams to understand how people work, where they encounter challenges and how technology and better processes can make their jobs easier and our business more effective.

What you will do

Become a Business Systems Expert

You will develop strong expertise in the applications supporting our European operations and become a trusted point of contact for our business users.

A major focus will be our ERP environment, supporting processes such as:

  • Purchasing and purchase orders

  • Goods and invoice receipt

  • Rental contracts

  • Equipment on-hire and off-hire

  • Recurring and final billing

  • Credit notes and ad-hoc invoicing

  • Customer, supplier and item master data

You will also support the effective use of CRM, Microsoft 365 and other operational applications.

Experience with inspHire, Zoho or Twinfield would be advantageous, but previous knowledge of our specific applications is not essential if you have strong ERP/business systems experience and learn quickly.

Help People Get the Best From Technology

You will work directly with colleagues across our branches to understand challenges, answer questions and identify better ways of working.

That includes:

  • Providing practical systems and process support

  • Training new and existing users

  • Developing SOPs, quick-reference guides and training materials

  • Creating screen recordings and short training videos

  • Building a structured, version-controlled knowledge library

  • Identifying recurring problems and addressing their root causes

Most importantly, you will explain the why, not only the how.

Connect Systems With Business Reality

Good systems only create good information when they are used correctly.

You will therefore work closely with Operations, Sales, Finance, Fleet and other Shared Services functions to improve the quality and consistency of the processes behind our data.

You will help us ensure that operational information, CRM pipelines, rental transactions, margins and management KPIs accurately reflect what is happening in the business.

Listen, Challenge and Improve

Our branches know their business and will bring you ideas and requirements.

Your job is not simply to say yes.

You will listen, understand the underlying need and assess whether the best answer is a change to a system, process, training or something else.

For larger initiatives, you will help structure requirements, assess benefits, costs, effort and risks, and make clear recommendations to leadership.

Lead a Small Team

You will lead a developing Branch Support function, expected to include approximately three team members across business support and IT/helpdesk activities.

This remains a hands-on role. You will lead the team while actively participating in support, training, problem solving and improvement initiatives yourself.

Stay Curious

Technology is changing quickly and we want to take advantage of it.

You do not need to be an AI expert, but you should be curious about tools such as Microsoft Copilot, automation and new ways technology can help colleagues work more effectively.

The Person We Are Looking For

Systems knowledge matters, but how you work with people matters just as much.

You are someone who:

  • Listens before proposing a solution

  • Is patient and enjoys explaining things

  • Can train and support colleagues with different levels of systems experience

  • Builds credibility and strong working relationships

  • Can persuade and influence without relying on hierarchy

  • Is comfortable constructively challenging a request

  • Is pragmatic and realistic about priorities, resources and costs

  • Learns new business processes quickly

  • Enjoys solving problems

  • Is comfortable being visible and close to the operational business

  • Is curious about technology and AI

You should be equally comfortable discussing a process with a branch administrator, working through a systems problem with IT, understanding a commercial requirement from Sales or presenting a recommendation to leadership.

European Scope

The role supports operations across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France.

Regular interaction with the branches is a fundamental part of the position. You should therefore be willing to travel across our European locations, build strong relationships with local teams and spend time understanding how our operations work in practice.

Regular office presence is also expected, currently anticipated at up to three days per week at our office in Potsdam.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to shape a developing European support function rather than simply inherit an established helpdesk.

You will have the opportunity to influence:

  • How we use our business systems

  • How we support and train users

  • How processes are standardised across countries

  • How knowledge is documented and shared

  • How new technology and AI are adopted

  • How Branch Support develops as our European organisation evolves

If you enjoy bringing together people, processes and technology and want a role where you can see the practical impact of your work across the business, we would like to hear from you.

description:

Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden.

Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten.

Warum YLAB

Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard.

Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt.

Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt.

Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch.

Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden.

Was wir bieten

  • Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht.

  • Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst.

  • Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt.

  • Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln.

Über die Rolle

Wie versteht ein Sprachmodell eine Vierjährige? Und wie erklärt es ihr die Welt, ohne sie zu überfordern? Dazu gibt es kaum Paper und keine Benchmarks. Genau da setzt du an.

Du bist unsere erste dedizierte Research-Stelle. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von KI, Sprache und Pädagogik, mit echten Familien statt Laborbedingungen und mit direktem Draht ins Produkt.

Was dich erwartet: offene Fragen mit Substanz, ein Fachbeirat aus Bildung und Psychologie und die Freiheit, Studien so zu bauen, wie sie sein müssen.

Wie du uns helfen kannst

  • Du entwirfst und machst Studien mit Kindern und Familien. Von der Beobachtung im Wohnzimmer bis zum strukturierten Test.

  • Du baust Methoden, um altersgerechte Antworten zu bewerten: Was heißt verständlich, was heißt zu viel?

  • Du übersetzt Erkenntnisse in Modell- und Produktentscheidungen, zusammen mit Engineering und Pädagogik.

  • Du behältst die Forschung im Blick (Child-Computer Interaction, Speech, LLM-Evals) und holst rein, was uns weiterbringt.

  • Du teilst, was wir lernen. Wir forschen nicht für die Schublade.

Melde dich, wenn:

  • Du hast einen Research-Hintergrund, etwa HCI, Psychologie, Linguistik oder ML.

  • Du hast schon mit Nutzer:innen geforscht, am besten mit Kindern.

  • Du kannst beides: Interviews auswerten und saubere Metriken bauen.

  • Du schreibst klar. Für Paper genauso wie für Produktentscheidungen.

  • Du magst es, wenn deine Forschung nächste Woche im Prototyp steckt.

Eher nicht, wenn: du Forschung als Selbstzweck siehst oder zwei Jahre Vorlauf brauchst, bevor etwas testbar ist.

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

As an Enterprise AE at incident, you sell to the engineering leaders who cannot afford to get incidents wrong, and every deal you close is one more company that handles its worst day better.

What that looks like day to day

As an Enterprise AE at incident, you're selling into the biggest and most complex accounts we go after, the ones where an incident going badly becomes a board-level problem. Intercom, Etsy, Miro, HashiCorp and StubHub are already customers, so you're not cold-starting a story nobody believes. The product has real market fit and it is nowhere near fully capitalised. That gap is the whole opportunity.

The team you're joining are seasoned sellers who are as much strategic partners and product evangelists as they are closers. Enterprise cycles here mean six or seven decision-makers, technical buyers who will test you properly, and C-level conversations where you need to be credible immediately. You'll run demos alongside SE's, and the feedback you bring back goes to a product team that ships in hours and days, not quarters.

Sales isn't a function bolted onto the side of this business, it's central to how we win. You'll work with leadership on building sales process rather than inheriting a finished one, and challenging how we do things is the job itself, not something you get credit for on top.

We're AI-forward, founded by engineers, and everyone here has unlimited Claude access. We expect you to use it properly: researching accounts, prepping deals, and moving faster than the rep across the table at a legacy vendor.

Who you are

  • You've closed $100k+ new business at the top end of enterprise, and you can talk me through how you actually did it, not just what the number was.

  • You're comfortable in a room full of engineers and CTOs. Technical buyers don't faze you, and you know the difference between selling to them and selling at them.

  • You're a proper hunter. You've got more than one way into an account, and a run of rejection doesn't take the wind out of you.

  • You build the case with evidence. Data, the right customer story, real product knowledge, whatever it takes to move that particular stakeholder.

  • You've got opinions about the product and you share them. The best reps here are the ones product actually listens to.

  • You're good to work with. You'll be close to leadership, SEs and CSMs, and you care about being someone people want in the room.

You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary.

title: Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique
description:
Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie.

Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels.

Avec une feuille de route pragmatique et progressive, Quandela déploie depuis 2023 des systèmes de niveau industriel, tout en développant les futures générations d’ordinateurs quantiques tolérants aux pannes, capables de passer à l’échelle grâce à l’intégration de milliers de composants photoniques.

Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes.

En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀

À propos du poste

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy.

Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats, nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration.

Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation.

Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. La compréhension et l'utilisation des systèmes de vide et de pompage feront partie de vos activités, en tant qu'éléments nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des installations cryogéniques.

Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés.

Selon les besoins, vous pourrez apporter un support technique à distance ou intervenir ponctuellement sur les systèmes installés chez nos clients, en France ou à l'international.

Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série, avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production.

Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes.

Missions principales

Intégration et validation des équipements dans les cryostats

Vous réalisez l'intégration de composants et sous-ensembles, parfois sensibles et délicats, au sein des cryostats. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage.

À ce titre, vous :

  • Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration.
  • Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles, en appliquant les précautions et méthodes adaptées à leur fragilité et à leurs contraintes d'intégration.
  • Réalisez le montage et l'intégration des composants et sous-ensembles dans les chambres de cryostats.
  • Assurez le passage, le cheminement et la fixation des câbles et connexions à l'intérieur des enceintes cryogéniques, en veillant à préserver l'intégrité des composants et des connexions.
  • Réalisez les opérations de thermalisation des câbles et composants, en tenant compte des contraintes thermiques et mécaniques.
  • Veillez au respect des contraintes d'intégration : encombrement, interfaces mécaniques, compatibilité des matériaux, propreté et contraintes thermiques.
  • Appliquez les bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de protection et de contrôle des composants tout au long des opérations d'intégration.
  • Réalisez les opérations de contrôle et de validation de l'intégration selon les protocoles définis.
  • Analysez les résultats des contrôles, identifiez les éventuelles non-conformités et participez à leur résolution.
  • Rédigez les rapports de validation associés et assurez la traçabilité des opérations réalisées.
  • Identifiez les difficultés d'intégration et proposez des améliorations adaptées.

Requirements

Compétences techniques – Indispensables

  • Titulaire d’un diplôme Bac+5 (Master ou diplôme d’ingénieur) en photonique, optique, électronique, mécanique, physique appliquée, physique de la matière condensée ou dans un domaine connexe. Un doctorat (PhD) serait apprécié.
  • Bonnes connaissances pratiques en cryogénie et compréhension des contraintes associées aux basses températures.
  • Connaissance des principes de transfert thermique, de thermalisation et des contraintes mécaniques liées aux environnements cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de montage et d'intégration de composants dans des systèmes cryogéniques.
  • Expérience dans la manipulation et l'assemblage de composants sensibles ou délicats, nécessitant précision et précautions particulières.
  • Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de propreté et de protection des composants lors des opérations d'intégration.
  • Compréhension du fonctionnement général des cryostats et de leurs équipements associés.
  • Connaissance des principes de mise sous vide et du fonctionnement des équipements de pompage nécessaires aux applications cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de mise en service, de refroidissement et de validation selon des procédures établies.
  • Capacité à réaliser et valider des opérations d'intégration selon des protocoles définis, à analyser les résultats et à rédiger les rapports associés.
  • Capacité à interpréter des mesures de température et de pression pour analyser le fonctionnement d'un système.
  • Capacité à réaliser les premières investigations techniques, à analyser les symptômes observés et à contribuer à l'identification des causes d'un dysfonctionnement, en collaboration avec les experts lorsque nécessaire.
  • Capacité à suivre des procédures tout en sachant identifier les situations nécessitant une analyse complémentaire ou l'intervention d'un expert.
  • Capacité à assurer le suivi des échéances de maintenance et des interventions réalisées.
  • Capacité à lire, appliquer et rédiger des procédures techniques et des rapports d'essais.
  • Sensibilisation aux risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements sous vide.

Qualités recherchées

  • Méticulosité et précision : capacité à réaliser des opérations d'assemblage délicates avec soin, patience et une attention constante aux détails.
  • Rigueur et respect des procédures : attention portée à la qualité des montages, à la propreté des équipements et à la protection des composants sensibles.
  • Autonomie et esprit d'initiative : capacité à prendre en charge les activités confiées, à identifier les difficultés et à solliciter les bons interlocuteurs lorsque nécessaire.
  • Esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes : capacité à comprendre le comportement des systèmes, à analyser les anomalies et à mener des investigations méthodiques.
  • Pragmatisme et sens pratique : goût pour les manipulations techniques, l'intégration et la résolution concrète de problèmes.
  • Organisation et traçabilité : capacité à documenter les opérations, suivre les essais et maintenir des historiques techniques fiables.
  • Curiosité technique et volonté d'apprendre : intérêt pour le fonctionnement des équipements et l'acquisition progressive d'une expertise approfondie.
  • Esprit d'amélioration continue : capacité à contribuer à la structuration des processus et à l'amélioration des méthodes de travail.
  • Capacité à travailler en équipe avec des profils techniques variés et à solliciter les experts appropriés.
  • Pédagogie et communication : capacité à transmettre des connaissances et à accompagner d'autres intervenants.
  • Respect des règles de sécurité et conscience des risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements de vide.

Benefits

Ce que nous offrons :

      • Un rôle à fort impact, avec de réelles responsabilités dès votre arrivée
      • Une équipe qui a envie de collaborer, de partager et de grandir avec vous
      • Un modèle de travail hybride : 3 jours par semaine sur site à Massy, 1 jour à Paris et 1 à 2 jours en télétravail
      • Une exposition quotidienne à l’ensemble de la stack quantique : des API haut niveau jusqu’au firmware bas niveau, et tout ce qui se trouve entre les deux

Ce processus est donné à titre indicatif et peut évoluer en fonction du poste.

About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

This is an opportunity to bring your ideas to life, to create your games, in an enjoyable and benign working environment among gaming lovers. Your games will be published by the worldwide leader in this field. You will get the chance to join a newly created small studio, focusing on creating and testing new hyper casual game prototypes to be published by Voodoo. You will have autonomy, a strong impact on the ideation, and a unique opportunity to reach hundreds of millions of players. You will take an innovative approach to gameplay ideas/features and give them their own spin. 

Role

With this role, you will be core to the company by contributing daily to important decisions with a multidisciplinary team of passionate and talented people. Flesh out the details of a game's design, oversee its testing, and revise the game in response to player feedback. Thanks to your creativity and your teamwork, let’s entertain millions of people with your hit games.


Our studios are looking for people who bring their own ideas and are always willing to compromise to move forward.

  • Support the Art director in the ideation and execution of the game’s vision.

  • Develop and optimize UX flows of new and existing features.

  • Create and maintain a comprehensive UI Style Bible and reusable component libraries.

  • Create high-quality 2D assets (menus, HUDs, buttons, icons, etc) and ensure optimal performance across mobile devices.

  • Work with Game Designers and the Product Team to ensure UI supports gameplay and accessibility goals.

  • Iterate quickly based on team feedback and live user data.

  • Propose creative ideas to boost player engagement and improve the user experience.

  • Nice to have: experience designing and implementing high-quality, scalable UI systems in Unity.

Profile

  • 3–5 years of UI art experience in mobile games

  • Proficient in Figma and Photoshop

  • Comfortable handling the implementation of UI and assets into Unity.

  • Experience building and maintaining UX/UI framework libraries within a game project

  • Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate prototyping and asset creation

  • Proactive mindset — able to identify product needs, source references, and drive solutions independently

  • Strong portfolio showcasing excellent UI art, visual polish, readability, and attention to detail.

  • Strong understanding of layout, composition, color, typography, visual hierarchy, iconography, and readability.

  • Ability to work independently in a small team, organize your own work, and move features forward without heavy process.

  • Nice to have: Experience creating UI animations, transitions, interaction feedback, or other motion design for game interfaces.

  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders and driving alignment around the visual quality and direction of UI.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.

  • AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work

  • Passion for mobile games.

Benefits

• Best-in-class compensation

• Other benefits according to the country you reside

title: Principal Software Engineer - XTM One
description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and drive the technical direction of XTM One, Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense and the agentic core of the XTM Suite.

XTM One creates and runs cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatches their intelligence across OpenCTI, OpenAEV and OpenGRC. It also hosts the suite's shared commons (unified authentication, consolidated datasets, configuration) and ships both as SaaS and on premises. Every XTM product connects to it, which makes its architecture one of the most structuring technical decisions at Filigran.

This is not a management role: no headcount, no sprints. You own the technical craft, standards and vision of XTM One, and you carry them into the XTM Foundation, where the engineering principles shared by all products are set for the 60+ engineers at Filigran.

💼 Your Responsibilities

Vision & architecture

  • Define and carry the technical vision of XTM One over the long term, with technical and product leadership.

  • Own the platform architecture: agent runtime and orchestration, tool and MCP integrations, data and context layers, APIs, permission model, shared commons.

  • Design for SaaS and on premises from day one: multitenancy, isolation, upgrade paths, configuration, operability in customer environments.

  • Arbitrate key decisions on scalability, resilience, security, maintainability and cost, including LLM latency and inference cost.

Standards & quality

  • Define the team's technical principles (architecture patterns, code quality, tooling, CI/CD, testing, development with AI assistants) and get them applied through docs, reviews, pairing and example.

  • Set the bar for observability and reliability of nondeterministic AI workloads: metrics, logs, traces, evaluations, and guardrails that make agent behavior measurable and debuggable in production.

  • Keep the right balance between features, technical debt and innovation.

Integration across products & XTM Foundation

  • Define how OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC and future products integrate with XTM One: contracts, authentication, data exchange, versioning.

  • Be a full member of the XTM Foundation: bring the XTM One perspective in, carry its decisions back, and keep coherence with the other Principal and Staff Engineers.

In the code

  • Write production code, prototype new approaches before the team adopts them, review critical PRs so that feedback teaches, and unblock engineers.

🤝 Who You'll Work With

  • Reports to: VP of Technology

  • Key collaborators: XTM One engineering team and its verticals; XTM Foundation (Principal and Staff Engineers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC); Product leadership; open source contributors.

  • Working model: embedded in the XTM One team, with regular XTM Foundation work.

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with technical leadership on complex production platforms.

  • Strong fullstack background, with a backend and architecture focus. You master TypeScript and Python, the core languages of XTM One, and you can take a feature from the data model all the way to the UI.

  • Strong system design: distributed systems, scalability, performance, security, observability.

  • A 360° view of software engineering: product need, design, code and tests, CI/CD, packaging and release, infrastructure and deployment, production operations, monitoring, incident response. A container image or an upgrade path is as familiar to you as an API contract.

  • Built and operated platforms delivered both as SaaS and on premises, including multitenancy and enterprise constraints.

  • Strong AI affinity. You've been building with LLMs by choice for a year or two, with LLM systems in production: agent frameworks, tool calling, MCP, RAG and vector search, evaluation, and the discipline to make them reliable.

  • Technical watch is part of the job. You keep up with your craft deliberately (reading, experimenting, prototyping) and turn what you learn into concrete proposals.

  • You define and carry technical standards: you raise the bar on a team, you don't just follow it.

  • Excellent written communication in English: design docs, ADRs and review comments that others learn from.

  • Autonomous and at ease in a remote, asynchronous culture; you drive problems to resolution and enable others instead of becoming a bottleneck.

  • Bonus: cybersecurity domain knowledge (CTI, CTEM, MITRE ATT&CK, STIX/TAXII); extensible plugin or tool ecosystems; open source contributions or maintainership.

🛡️ About XTM One

XTM One is Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense. It is dedicated to creating and running cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatching their intelligence across the products of the XTM Suite.

Every product of the XTM Suite is connected to XTM One to leverage AI agents for a more proactive platform that is easier to use. Within XTM One, agents can use and correlate data across products to make the most meaningful assessments and take the most relevant actions. XTM One also hosts shared commons such as unified authentication and consolidated datasets and configuration.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

About the Role

The Product Marketing Manager will own how Nabla positions, launches, and drives adoption of the product with clinicians across their entire journey — from onboarding and activation through engagement and retention.

This is product marketing where the message ships directly to the user. You own the narrative for every new feature launch, then own the in-app and email programs that turn that narrative into activation.

You'll define the segmentation, write the positioning, ship the campaigns, and measure whether they actually moved adoption.

Userpilot is in place, but everything around it still needs to be built: the activation and adoption strategy, in-app and email templates, segmentation, cohort analysis, the process with Product Marketing peers, CSM, PM, and Design, and the campaign calendar.

This is a hands-on, highly operational PMM role. We need someone who lives in the tools, is data-driven, can test fast, structure the process, and turn usage insights into concrete positioning and messaging decisions.

Userpilot is the first step. Over time, this person will take ownership of the full communication stack across email, in-app, and other channels. The role works extremely closely with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, and Product Ops.

Nabla serves two distinct audiences, and lifecycle programs must work for both:

  • Self-serve clinicians, who discover, activate, and adopt the product largely on their own. Here, automated email and in-app communication carries most of the relationship — your messaging is the go-to-market motion.

  • Mid-market and enterprise health systems, managed by CSMs. Here the human relationship leads, and your programs must arm and reinforce the CSM — giving them timing, context, and content, never working around them.

You'll design each lifecycle so the right channel leads for each segment. On top of this, healthtech is a highly regulated industry with demanding clients: every communication must meet a high bar for accuracy, security, and professionalism, while still feeling personal and useful to busy clinicians.

Responsibilities

Feature Launch Positioning & Activation

  • Own weekly in-app launch communication for new features, end to end and at a fast cadence

  • Define the positioning and messaging for each release — what it is, why a clinician should care, what changes in their day

  • Design the in-app experience (placement, format, flow) for each launch

  • Validate messaging with Product Marketing peers, PM, and Design before shipping

  • Launch on time and coordinate across the relevant teams

  • Track performance (reach, engagement, adoption) for every launch and iterate quickly on results

  • Stay highly reactive to the product roadmap, turning new releases into clear, well-timed clinician communication

Lifecycle Strategy and Execution

  • Own the full lifecycle strategy across onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention, ensuring each stage of the practitioner journey is intentional, personalized, and measurable

  • Tailor segmentation, messaging, and cadence to the distinct needs of each segment:

    • For self-serve, build automated email and in-app programs that drive activation, adoption, and retention with minimal human touch

    • For mid-market and enterprise, build programs that complement and support CSMs

  • Direct and execute creative strategy for lifecycle channels — briefing, reviewing, and optimizing copy and design for brand consistency and message effectiveness

  • Build and maintain a clear campaign calendar across functions

Experimentation and Analytics

  • Lead a rigorous experimentation roadmap: A/B and multivariate testing of messaging, creative, cadence, segmentation, and value propositions

  • Define and own lifecycle KPIs, building reporting frameworks and sharing regular performance insights with marketing and cross-functional leadership

  • Partner with Data and Analytics on audience segmentation, behavioral signals, and AI-driven insights to enhance personalization at scale

  • Turn cohort and usage insights into concrete messaging and product-marketing actions

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, Product Ops, Clinical, and Brand to align lifecycle programs with broader business goals and the practitioner experience

  • Establish a clear, repeatable process across Product Marketing, CSM, PM, and Design for planning and shipping campaigns

  • Ensure all programs are developed and executed in compliance with HIPAA and applicable federal and state laws, partnering with Legal and Compliance as needed

Operations and Tooling

  • Take ownership of the full communication stack, starting with Userpilot

  • Evaluate and manage lifecycle marketing technology partnerships, recommending optimizations as we scale

  • Build and maintain process documentation, campaign playbooks, and training materials on internal platforms

  • Leverage AI tools as a core part of daily work (drafting, research, iteration) to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making

What We Are Looking For

  • 3-5 years in B2B product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or product-led growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of in-app channels

  • Proven ability to craft positioning and messaging for product launches and to ship it yourself, not hand it off

  • Deep expertise across the full post-signup funnel (onboarding, activation, engagement, retention)

  • Strong Product DNA, with sharp attention to user workflows and the details that shape the product experience

  • Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to translate complex data into clear hypotheses, actionable insights, and business recommendations

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to manage stakeholder expectations, influence without authority, and build alignment across diverse teams

  • Track record of building and scaling programs that drove measurable growth in adoption, engagement, and retention

  • Comfortable in a highly regulated, high-stakes industry (healthtech) with demanding clients, where accuracy, security, and compliance are non-negotiable

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Userpilot and HubSpot

  • Familiarity with Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar

  • Experience in a regulated industry: healthcare, behavioral health, or health-adjacent

  • Experience with AI-powered personalization, segmentation tools, or ML-informed campaign optimization

  • Experience marketing to a professional or clinical end user

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

Data analist Lenen, Sparen & Retailbeleggen
description:
De afdeling Lenen, Sparen en Retailbeleggen (LSR) houdt toezicht op financiële producten en diensten voor consumenten, zoals hypotheken, kredieten, sparen, betalen en beleggen. We zorgen dat informatie duidelijk is en dat online dienstverlening goed toegankelijk is. Samen zorgen we dat het klantbelang centraal staat, vooral voor kwetsbare groepen.

 

Ons toezicht richt zich op het herkennen en aanpakken van risico’s voor consumenten. We willen dit zo snel en effectief mogelijk doen. Om meer impact te maken, gebruiken we data op een slimme manier. Daarbij zoeken we continu naar signalen, toetsen we aannames en brengen we risico’s en mogelijke blinde vlekken in beeld. Zo kunnen we sneller inspelen op veranderingen in de financiële sector.

 

De vraagstukken waar je aan werkt zijn vaak nieuw, complex en actueel. Denk aan risico’s rond Buy Now Pay Later, online beleggingsplatformen, AI-toepassingen of ontwikkelingen in de cryptomarkt. Jouw analyses dragen direct bij aan keuzes die de AFM maakt in haar toezicht.

 

Dit ga je doen:

  • Samenwerken met toezichthouders om risico’s voor consumenten tijdig te signaleren.

  • Ontwikkelen van dataproducten die inzichten vertalen naar gerichte acties.

  • Implementeren van betrouwbare en schaalbare oplossingen voor effectiever toezicht.

  • Visualiseren van resultaten in dashboards die toezichthouders ondersteunen.

  • Kansen signaleren om processen slimmer in te richten en repetitief werk te automatiseren.

  • Experimenteren met nieuwe technieken zoals AI om toezicht slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken.

 

Team
Team Data Analyse & Innovatie is één van de vijf teams binnen de afdeling LSR. Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de Datagedreven Toezicht Strategie (DGT) van LSR.

 

Dit betekent dat het team toezichtsvragen vertaalt naar oplossingen met data. We bouwen aan een stevige basis en een duidelijke planning (roadmap) voor de hele afdeling. Ook helpt het team om data echt te gaan gebruiken in het toezicht. Zo kunnen we straks beter controleren of instellingen zich aan de regels houden, risico’s inschatten en slimme technologie zoals AI inzetten om ons werk sneller en efficiënter te maken. Ook kijkt het team naar risico’s van nieuwe technologie in de financiële sector. Zo spelen we een belangrijke rol in het tijdig herkennen van risico’s.

 

De deadline voor deze vacature is 25 november 2026.


Dit vragen we:

⭐ Een afgeronde WO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Data Science, Business Analytics, Wiskunde, Econometrie, Technische Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare (bèta) studie met een sterke analytische of statistische component.

⭐ Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring en kennis van het data/science werkveld en de daarbij behorende tools en technieken. Hierbij is ervaring met Microsoft Power BI, SQL, Python, Azure Data Bricks een vereiste.

⭐Kennis van softwareontwikkeling, versiebeheer, codereview en unit testing is vereist.

⭐ Analytisch sterk: het vermogen om complexe datasets te analyseren, patronen te herkennen en inzichten te genereren. Je neemt informatie niet zonder meer aan, toetst aannames en identificeert risico’s, afwijkingen en mogelijke blinde vlekken.

⭐ Proactieve houding: je werkt graag samen en draagt bij aan het gezamenlijke succes, tegelijkertijd kan je zelfstandig knopen doorhakken en analyses omzetten in concrete en bruikbare uitkomsten.

⭐ Communicatieve vaardigheden: je kunt complexe technische informatie helder en beknopt overbrengen aan niet of minder-technische collega’s. Ervaring met datavisualisatie om gegevens begrijpelijk en toegankelijk te presenteren voor verschillende belanghebbenden.

 

Please note: excellent proficiency in Dutch, both verbal and written, is required for this position.
