We are looking for a Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tool Development intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role

We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join our Combustion Devices team and contribute to the development of engineering tools supporting the design and analysis of liquid rocket engine injectors.

During this internship, you will work on computational tools to automate and accelerate the preliminary design and assessment of injector configurations.

Your work will focus on three main areas:

  • Injector layout & manifold modelling: develop tools to automate injector element layouts and associated fuel and oxidiser manifolds, based on geometrical, fluid-dynamic and engineering design rules.
  • Injector spray-pattern visualisation: develop a qualitative visualisation of spray/jet directions, cone angles, spatial coverage and interactions between neighbouring injector elements.
  • Face-plate thermal assessment: contribute to a physics-based methodology to assess thermal loads based on injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle, injection conditions and combustion behaviour.


The developed tools will support the team in rapidly comparing injector configurations, identifying potential performance and thermal risks, and improving the overall preliminary design process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing injector design methodologies, engineering rules and relevant technical literature.
  • Develop algorithms for automated injector layout and fuel/oxidiser manifold generation.
  • Implement engineering models and methodologies in MATLAB and Python.
  • Develop an injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • Develop preliminary models to assess injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Use relevant parameters such as injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle and injection/combustion conditions.
  • Define relevant CFD analysis needs and interpret available CFD and experimental data.
  • Validate models and tools against available analytical, numerical, experimental or literature data.
  • Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future development and integration into the Combustion Devices design process.


What you need to be successful

  • Final-year student or recent graduate in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong programming skills, particularly in MATLAB and Python.
  • Good understanding of:
    • Fluid mechanics
    • Thermodynamics and heat transfer
    • Numerical methods and computational modelling
  • Experience with data processing, numerical analysis or scientific computing.
  • Ability to translate physical and engineering requirements into computational models and algorithms.
  • Ability to analyse numerical results and identify relevant physical trends.
  • Critical thinking when assessing modelling assumptions and engineering correlations.
  • Interest in rocket propulsion, combustion devices and liquid-propellant injection systems.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Autonomous, structured and methodical approach.
  • Curiosity and willingness to explore unfamiliar technical topics.

title: Vice President Finance (all genders)
description:
Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As Vice President Finance (all genders), you will lead and further professionalise our global Finance function, ensuring the company has the financial transparency, processes, and steering mechanisms required to scale successfully.

This role combines strategic financial leadership with hands-on ownership of all core finance activities, including financial planning, controlling, accounting, treasury, payroll, tax, reporting, and finance operations. You will lead a growing team and continue the transformation of Finance from a scale-up function into a mature, globally operating business partner.

Beyond running the existing function, you will proactively identify future challenges and opportunities, helping leadership make well-informed decisions through robust planning, forecasting, business insights, and financial modeling. You will act as a trusted partner to the C-Level and leadership, and our corporate shareholder, ensuring Finance is not only a reporting function but a strategic driver of long-term success.

This is a full-time hybrid role, with 1-2 days per week working from our Berlin office.

Your Mission

Financial Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, develop, and inspire the Finance team across all functional areas.
  • Manage and support direct reports, including Accounting, Controlling, and Finance Operations.
  • Build organisational capabilities, processes, and structures required for the next stage of growth.
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on ownership, accuracy, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure appropriate resource planning and team development.

Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Own the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes from a financial perspective.
  • Develop scalable planning structures and financial governance frameworks across all departments.
  • Ensure financial targets are translated into operational plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Continuously improve forecast quality and business visibility.
  • Support leadership with scenario planning and strategic decision-making.

Controlling & Business Partnering

  • Further develop financial controlling processes and management reporting.
  • Partner with department leaders to improve financial planning, cost transparency, and performance management.
  • Challenge assumptions, identify risks early, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Establish a culture of financial accountability throughout the organisation.
  • Drive improvements in cost tracking, resource planning, and investment prioritisation.

Financial Reporting & Accounting

  • Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting across all entities and markets.
  • Oversee accounting, payroll, tax, treasury, and financial operations.
  • Ensure compliance with statutory, tax, and internal reporting requirements.
  • Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing processes.
  • Coordinate external audits and relevant financial reviews.

Corporate & Shareholder Finance

  • Serve as the primary financial interface to our corporate shareholder and relevant stakeholders.
  • Prepare board and shareholder reporting materials.
  • Support capital planning and long-term financial strategy.
  • Ensure transparency and professionalism in all financial communications.

Global Finance Operations

  • Own Finance processes across all markets.
  • Ensure consistency of financial standards and reporting across countries.
  • Support international expansion through scalable financial structures and processes.
  • Promote best-practice sharing and operational alignment across markets.

Finance Systems, Data & Automation

  • Drive the professionalisation and automation of Finance processes.
  • Improve the quality, availability, and utilisation of financial data.
  • Define requirements for Finance tooling, reporting, and workflow improvements.
  • Collaborate with Strategic Operations, Data, Product, and Engineering teams on automation initiatives.
  • Leverage technology and AI-enabled solutions to increase efficiency and decision quality.

Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Continuously evaluate and improve Finance processes, controls, and governance structures with a strong focus on simplicity and ease of use.
  • Reduce manual effort through standardisation and automation.
  • Implement scalable operating models that support company growth.
  • Ensure Finance remains fit for purpose as organisational complexity increases.

Requirements

What You Need to Succeed

Education:

Wie selqo im Markt wahrgenommen wird, entscheidet sich jetzt. title: Consultant SAP S/4HANA Transformation
description:
Für viele Unternehmen ist S/4HANA ein Pflicht-Upgrade. Bei UNITY ist es deine Mission, daraus eine echte unternehmerische Entscheidung für unsere Kunden zu machen: Wohin soll sich die Prozess- und Systemlandschaft bewegen? Was kostet welcher Weg und wer setzt ihn um? Und wie bleibt das Programm steuerbar? Du sitzt auf der Seite des Kunden. Du gestaltest End-to-End-Prozesse, Zielarchitektur und Programmsteuerung. Die technische Implementierung übernimmt unser Partnernetzwerk.

Unser Anspruch als Business Integrator: Wir schützen das, was unsere Kunden vom Wettbewerb unterscheidet (wir nennen das „Prozess-DNA“) und helfen ihnen zu verstehen, was sich nicht unterscheiden sollte.

Das erwartet dich

  • Transformationspfad entwickeln: Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden und Team an Vorprojekten zur Auswahl von ERP-Systemen samt Definition von Zielbild, Leitplanken, Zielarchitektur, Deploymentvariante (RISE vs. GROW, Cloud vs. On-Premise) und Transformationspfad (Greenfield, Brownfield, Lift-&-Shift) inklusive Business Case.

  • Zielarchitektur mitgestalten: Du arbeitest an Clean-Core-Konzepten, an SAP Business AI Platform (BAIP) – auf Basis von SAP BTP als Entkopplungsplattform und an Datenstrategien, etwa für Datasphere oder SAP Analytics Cloud.

  • Programme transparent begleiten: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung einer tragfähigen Roadmap und sorgst im PMO mit Tools wie SAP Signavio, LeanIX und SAP Cloud ALM für Klarheit über Fortschritt, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten.

  • Den richtigen Partner an Bord holen: Du gestaltest Transformationsausschreibungen – im Mittelstand und Konzern ebenso wie vergaberechtskonform bei öffentlichen Auftraggebern und Kliniken.

  • KI dort einsetzen, wo sie wirkt: Du identifizierst Use Cases for SAP Business AI und Joule, etwa in der Custom-Code-Analyse, bei der Datenqualität oder mit unseren KI-Agents in Einkauf, Supply Chain und Order-to-Cash.

  • Branchenwissen aufbauen: Du arbeitest in Industrie und Handel, im Krankenhaus (IS-H-Ablösung, KIS-Szenarien) oder in der Energiewirtschaft (IS-U).

Künstliche Intelligenz @UNITY

Bei UNITY arbeitest du mit KI, die du selbst mitgestalten kannst: die eigenentwickelte UNITY X-Plattform gibt dir Zugriff auf verschiedene Claude-, ChatGPT & Gemini Modelle. Copilot und Claude-Modelle sind direkt in Teams und den Microsoft-Anwendungen verfügbar. In Copilot Studio kannst du außerdem eigene Agenten bauen, wenn du willst. UNITY Coding Communities, Hackathons, AI Labs und das AI Trainings Camp geben dir Raum, eigene Lösungen für intern und für Kunden zu bauen.

Das bringst du mit

Must-haves Junior

  • Erste Praxiserfahrung entweder in einer Management- oder IT-Beratung oder auf Kundenseite in der Industrie

  • Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse in mindestens einem Bereich, zum Beispiel Finance, Logistik, Einkauf, Produktion oder Vertrieb, und Freude daran, diese zu analysieren und zu optimieren

  • Grundkenntnisse der SAP-Vorgehensmodelle, etwa SAP Activate, und der Migrationsszenarien

  • Die Fähigkeit, KI wirksam und sicher anzuwenden.

  • Prägnante Kommunikation und Präsentation auf Deutsch (C1) und Englisch (mindestens B2)

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, der Produktionstechnik oder ein vergleichbarer Abschluss mit technischem oder betriebswirtschaftlichem Schwerpunkt

Idealerweise

  • Erste Erfahrungen aus SAP-S/4HANA-Projekten

  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit SAP BTP, Signavio oder LeanIX

  • Branchenerfahrung in Industrie, Healthcare oder Energie

  • (Senior Level): Entwicklung Architektur-Roadmaps rund um Clean Core und BTP.

  • (Senior Level): Übernahme von Teilprojektleitungen oder Streamleadfunktion.

Senior Level: Das bringst du zusätzlich mit

  • Du hast bereits mindestens eine S/4HANA-Transformation über mehrere Phasen begleitet.

  • Du bist an der Steuerung von Implementierungspartnern beteiligt gewesen und hast Scope-Entscheidungen mit dem Management deiner Kunden mitgetroffen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Sammlung und Darstellung von Use Cases und/oder Change-Requests im Kontext von SAP S/4HANA Transformations-Programmen.

  • Juniors coachst du im Projekt, und du bringst eigene Ideen in unser SAP-Leistungsangebot ein.

Ehrlich gesagt: Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn du vor allem selbst customizen oder in ABAP entwickeln willst. Die Implementierung liegt bei unseren Partnern, deine Stärke liegt im Steuern, Gestalten und Entscheiden. Sie passt auch nicht, wenn du lieber ein Modul tief betreust, als den Blick über Prozesse, Daten und Organisation hinweg zu weiten. Wenn dich dagegen die Frage reizt, wie aus einem ERP-Projekt messbarer Business-Nutzen wird, dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Deine Chancen und Möglichkeiten

  • Projekte mit Substanz: Du begleitest Transformationsprogramme von der Strategie bis zum Go-Live, in Industrie, Healthcare und Energie, und siehst, wie aus einem ERP-Projekt Business-Nutzen wird.

  • Fachlicher Austausch auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest mit den Köpfen hinter unserem SAP-Angebot, darunter unsere Heads of SAP Architecture & Innovation und SAP Transformation Excellence.

  • Partnernetzwerk statt Einzelkämpfertum: Du steuerst gemeinsam mit Implementierungspartnern, statt alles selbst zu bauen, und lernst dabei die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette einer Transformation kennen.

  • SAP-Innovation aus erster Hand: Mit unserem zentralen KI-Team, AI Labs und Hackathons entwickelst du Business-AI-Use-Cases für den SAP-Kontext mit.

  • Entwicklung vom Junior zum Senior: Deine SAP-Laufbahn ist bei uns kein Zufall, sondern ein Pfad bis zur Projektleitung und Architekturverantwortung. UNITY unterstützt diese Entwicklung mit konkreten Zertifizierungen, die zu deinem Entwicklungsziel passen, sowie einem breiten Portfolio an Fach- und Persönlichkeitsentwicklungsschulungen.

  • KI, die wir selbst bauen: Zentrales KI-Team, AI Labs, Hackathons und unsere eigene UNITY X-Plattform – du entwickelst Business-AI-Use-Cases mit, statt sie nur zu präsentieren.

  • Wohnort-Freiheit: Du arbeitest an dem deutschen UNITY-Standort, der zu dir passt, zur Auswahl stehen neun.

  • Verwirkliche mit uns deine Big Five for Life in einer Kultur, die von Vertrauen, Authentizität und Zusammenhalt geprägt ist.

  • Und obendrauf: Unternehmerischer Freiraum für eigene Ideen, flexible Arbeitsmodelle (u. a. Homeoffice), Sabbaticals, persönliches Coaching, Mentoring und UNITYacademy, ein individuelles Mobilitätskonzept, JobRad, Urban Sports Club und mehr.

Du begeisterst dich für B2B SaaS Software? Dein TikTok- und Insta-Feed ist voller UI-Inspirationen? Du weißt, dass Software nicht nur funktional sein muss, sondern auch ein Ort zum Wohlfühlen sein sollte. Bist du stets am Puls der Zeit, was die neusten Trends im Bereich Software-Design angeht?

Dann solltest du jetzt weiterlesen!

Wir bei everii haben uns eine klare Mission gesetzt: Professional Services Automation-Software bauen, die Agenturen, IT-Dienstleister und Beratungen wirklich voranbringt – nicht bloß verwaltet.

Mit TEAMBOX, untermStrich, MOCO und weiteren Produkten unter einem Dach sind wir der führende PSA-Anbieter im DACH-Raum. Täglich vertrauen über 200.000 Menschen in mehr als 13.000 Unternehmen auf unsere Software – von kleinen Kreativagenturen bis hin zu großen Playern.

Wir sind ein Team von knapp über 100 Leuten, verteilt auf Deutschland, Österreich, die Schweiz und England. Was uns zusammenhält? Eine echte Feedbackkultur, kurze Wege und das gemeinsame Ziel, die beste Software in unserem Segment zu bauen. Wer bei uns anfängt, kommt nicht in ein starres Korsett – sondern in ein Umfeld, in dem Ideen zählen und Verantwortung kein Fremdwort ist.

Wir wachsen – durch starke Produkte, organisch und gezielte Akquisitionen.
Das bedeutet: Du gestaltest mit, nicht irgendwann, sondern von Tag eins an.

Was dich erwartet:

In unserem Angebot haben wir eine spannende, abwechslungsreiche Stelle als UI / UX Designer im everii Kosmos – mit der Möglichkeit, aktiv die Zukunft eines unserer Kern-Produkte mitzugestalten.

Als UI / UX Designer gestaltest du aktiv die Zukunft von TEAMBOX, unserer ERP-Lösung für Agenturen, Beratungen und projektbasierte Dienstleister.

Auf Basis von Feature-Konzepten entwirfst du ansprechende UI/UX Designs in Figma – und bringst dabei stets dein eigenes Feedback aus UI/UX Perspektive ein, statt Konzepte nur „blind“ umzusetzen.

Du bist im engen Austausch mit unseren Kunden und Kundenteams, kennst ihre Anforderungen genau und entwickelst unsere Produkte kontinuierlich weiter.

Ein besonderes Highlight: Du begleitest und prägst das Re-Design von TEAMBOX und gestaltest den Look & Feel aktiv mit.

Das klingt nach dir? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Perfect Match!

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • UI / UX Designer: Du erstellst auf Basis der Konzepte unseres Produktmanagements Designs für TEAMBOX, unsere All-in-One-Lösung für Agenturen, Beratungen und IT-Dienstleister.
  • UX-Flows gestalten: Du denkst, kreierst und verbesserst UX-Flows und sorgst dafür, dass sich die Software für unsere Kunden intuitiv und stimmig anfühlt.
  • Designsprache weiterentwickeln: Du bringst unsere Designsprache auf das nächste Level.
  • Designumbau unseres Produkts: Aktuell arbeiten wir an einem größeren Designumbau. Du arbeitest hier im absoluten Herzen des Produkts.
  • Regelmäßiger Kundenkontakt: Du bist im ständigen Austausch mit unseren Kunden und Kundenteams, um ihre Anforderungen und Prozesse genau zu kennen.

Qualifikation

Deine Skills

  • Erfahrung im UI / UX Design: Du hast bereits im Design für Software-Produkte gearbeitet und kannst mit den gängigen Tools (wir nutzen z. B. Figma und Youtrack) umgehen.
  • AI-Tools im Workflow: Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deinem Design-Alltag, um Prozesse zu beschleunigen und Ideen schneller zu validieren.
  • Erfahrung im B2B Softwarebereich: Du hast dich bereits explizit mit B2B SaaS Software beschäftigt. Begriffe wie MRR, CAC, LTV sind für dich keine Fremdwörter.
  • Trendbewusstsein: Du bringst Drive mit und verfolgst die aktuellen Trends im Bereich Softwaredesign und Gestaltung.
  • Agentur-, oder Consultingumfeld: Idealerweise hast du Kenntnisse aus dem Agentur-, oder Consultingumfeld, die du im Produktdesign einbringen kannst.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse für den Austausch mit Kunden und mit unseren Teams.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit echtem Spielraum: Top Equipment inklusive. Idealerweise bist du 2–3 Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office, aber wenn mal eine ganze Woche remote passt, ist das kein Problem.
  • Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team: Produkt und Entwicklung arbeiten direkt miteinander. Du bist vom ersten Tag an ein fester Bestandteil des Teams – nicht Zuarbeiter, sondern Mitgestalter.
  • Wachstum, das sich anfühlt: Kein Stillstand. Herausforderungen, die dich fordern, und regelmäßiges Feedback, das dich weiterbringt.
  • Kurze Wege, echte Mitsprache: Flache Hierarchien bedeuten bei uns nicht nur weniger Meetings, sondern auch: deine Perspektive zählt, nicht dein Titel.
  • Ein Team, das sich freut, dich kennenzulernen: Offene Kultur, ehrliche Kommunikation, keine Ellenbogen.
  • Wohlatmosphäre & Team-Kultur: Modernes Büro im Herzen von Hamburg mit frischem Obst, Kaffee, gekühlten Getränken und einem gemeinsamen wöchentlichen Frühstück.
  • Möglichkeit auf Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket & Lunch (über EDENRED/Sachbezug).

Lust, die Zukunft mitzugestalten?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem Lebenslauf, deinem Portfolio & deiner Gehaltsvorstellung – der Start ist ab sofort bzw. zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt möglich! 🚀

title: Werkstudent / Praktikant Content Marketing & Communications
description:
Über uns

toern ist ein wachsendes AI-Startup aus Hamburg, das den Retourenprozess im E-Commerce neu denkt. Mit unserer automatisierten All-in-One-Lösung helfen wir Shopify-Shops wie Saint Sass, NINETY-9 oder dem 1. FC Köln, Rückgaben effizienter zu managen, Prozesse zu vereinfachen und aus Retourendaten wertvolle Business-Insights zu gewinnen.

Wir wollen, dass E-Commerce-Brands toern überall finden, wo sie nach einer Retourenlösung suchen – bei Google, auf LinkedIn oder in ChatGPT. Dafür bauen wir unseren Content- und Marketingbereich weiter aus.

Du hast Lust, spannende Geschichten zu erzählen, kreative Inhalte zu entwickeln und Marketing aktiv mitzugestalten? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns Content und Kommunikation für die Ära der KI-Suche!

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest direkt mit Alena, unserer Gründerin, und Rike, unserer Marketing Managerin, zusammen. Dabei übernimmst du eigene Projekte und begleitest sie von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung.

Website & Content: Du schreibst und optimierst Landingpages, Blogartikel und Ratgeber rund um Retouren, Shopify und E-Commerce-Operations.

GEO & SEO: Du sorgst dafür, dass toern in KI-Suchen wie ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Overviews sichtbar wird. Dafür entwickelst du strukturierte Inhalte, FAQs und Vergleichsseiten, beobachtest unsere Sichtbarkeit und leitest Optimierungen ab.

Case Studies & Storytelling: Du führst Interviews mit unseren Kunden, arbeitest spannende Zahlen und Ergebnisse heraus und verwandelst sie in überzeugende Case Studies für Website, Sales und Social Media.

Social Media: Du entwickelst kreative Inhalte für LinkedIn und Instagram – von Posts und Karussells bis hin zu Video-Formaten.

Events & Teamkultur: Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung und Organisation von Messen und Events, kümmerst dich um die Einladung und Kommunikation mit Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass vor Ort alles rundläuft. Außerdem planst und organisierst du interne Teamevents und bringst eigene Ideen für gemeinsame Aktivitäten ein.

AI im Marketing: Du nutzt AI-Tools aktiv für Recherche, Textentwürfe und Visuals und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns neue Workflows, um Content smarter und effizienter zu erstellen.

Dein Profil

  • Du studierst Marketing, Kommunikation, Journalismus, Medien, BWL oder etwas Vergleichbares (für das Praktikum ist ein Pflichtpraktikum erforderlich).
  • Du schreibst gerne und kannst komplexe Themen verständlich, kreativ und auf den Punkt bringen.
  • Du hast ein Gespür für Social Media und weißt, welche Inhalte auf LinkedIn und Instagram funktionieren.
  • Du interessierst dich für SEO und die Zukunft der Suche durch KI. Erste Erfahrungen mit GEO sind ein Plus.
  • Du bist kreativ und sicher im Umgang mit Tools wie Canva oder Figma. Erste Erfahrungen mit Video-Editing (z. B. CapCut) sind willkommen.
  • Du organisierst gerne, behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick und hast Lust, Events eigenständig mit vorzubereiten.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und hast eine Hands-on-Mentalität.
  • Du bist AI-affin und nutzt KI nicht nur als Tool, sondern denkst aktiv mit, wie sich Marketing und Content verbessern kann.
  • Du hast Interesse an E-Commerce, SaaS und der Startup-Welt.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Gründerin: kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Austausch und Verantwortung ab Tag eins.
  • Eigene Projekte & Formate: Deine Ideen werden umgesetzt und deine Inhalte haben einen sichtbaren Impact auf Reichweite und Leads.
  • Steile Lernkurve: Du sammelst praktische Erfahrung in Content Marketing, GEO, SEO und B2B-Marketing in einem AI-Startup.
  • Einblicke hinter die Kulissen: Du lernst den Aufbau eines Startups kennen und arbeitest an echten Kund aus dem E-Commerce.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir finden ein Modell, das gut zu deinem Studium passt, inklusive Remote-Anteil.
  • Schönes Office: Unser Büro liegt in der Hamburger Speicherstadt inklusive Siebträgermaschine, Snacks und Team-Events.
  • Teamspirit: Wir arbeiten eng zusammen, feiern gemeinsame Erfolge und organisieren regelmäßig Aktivitäten als Team.
  • Urban Sports Club: Bleib auch neben der Arbeit aktiv.

Ready to toern things around?

Du hast Lust, Content zu gestalten, Events mitzuorganisieren und in einem ambitionierten Startup Verantwortung zu übernehmen?

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Make Zattoo the TV platform partner of choice for operators and broadcasters in Eastern and Northern Europe. This role turns new markets into lasting revenue and shapes Zattoo’s next stage of growth. You will join a close-knit team working across Germany and Switzerland that values trust, collaboration and hands-on ownership over hierarchy and heavy process.

THE TEAM

The Zattoo Business Sales Team is responsible for all sales activities related to Zattoo’s TV-as-a-Service and streaming technology offerings, including the End-to-End TV platform as well as Modular products such as Streaming, Ingest and Orchestration solutions. We work closely with Product, Portfolio Management, Marketing, Client Success and Project Management to bring complex solutions to market and build long-term customer relationships across different regions and customer segments.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build a new business pipeline across Eastern and Northern Europe and win telcos, ISPs, broadcasters and OTT platforms as long-term customers
  • Own complex, high-value deals end-to-end, from first conversation to signed contract
  • Navigate long decision cycles and orchestrate our Sales Engineering, Product and Legal teams to get deals over the line
  • Build lasting relationships with senior decision makers up to C-level
  • Shape tailored offers from our modular platform (INGEST, STREAM, ORCHESTRATE, E2E)
  • Be Zattoo’s face in your markets, at customer meetings, trade shows and partner events, and bring market insights back to Product

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Experience required (Must-have)

  • 10+ years in B2B enterprise sales, closing complex deals with long sales cycles
  • Proven track record selling to telcos, broadcasters, media companies or platform providers
  • Deep understanding of the TV, OTT and streaming market
  • Established network in Eastern and/or Northern European markets
  • Confident negotiating with C-level and procurement teams
  • Business fluent English

Nice to have

  • Language skills in one or more Eastern or Northern European languages
  • Experience selling modular tech or SaaS platforms
  • German language skills are advantageous

Behavioural Competencies

  • Ownership: Takes full responsibility for their markets and deals, without relying on a large sales support machine.
  • Honest Forecasting: Reports pipeline and forecast realistically and transparently, including bad news early.
  • Team Player: Works closely with Product, Sales Engineering and Legal and values collaboration over individual heroics.
  • Hands-on Mentality: Comfortable building structures and materials themselves where needed.
  • Long-term Thinking: Builds relationships for the long run instead of chasing quick wins.

WHY JOIN US?

At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

  • Reward: strong market competitive salary
  • Recharge: 30 days vacation plus public holidays
  • Regulate: trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year

Plus:

  • We're developing: Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days
  • We’re inclusive: ‘Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities
  • We’re healthy: Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!
  • We’re mobile: Discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals
  • We’re sociable: A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event

description:
Über YLAB

Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden.

Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene.

Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten.

Warum YLAB

Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard.

Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt.

Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

We are looking for an enthusiastic, driven, and proactive commercial analyst to join our expanding DACH go-to-market team. As a key member of our commercial team, you will play a crucial role in sourcing and qualifying leads, initiating outreach, and scheduling high-value conversations for our Account Executives. Your goal will be to create meaningful connections with healthcare practices and hospital groups, facilitating our mission to win across the DACH market.

  • Execute inbound and outbound campaigns using a mix of calls, emails, social selling, and product-led signals to qualify leads.

  • Schedule high-quality meetings and product demonstrations for Account Executives, ensuring smooth handoff of qualified opportunities.

  • Own and manage end-to-end sales cycles for small SMB customers, from initial outreach through to closing deals.

  • Maintain accurate records in HubSpot CRM, manage and optimise sales pipelines, and consistently meet targets for qualified leads generated.

  • Collaborate closely with Account Executives, Marketing, Product, Operations, and Customer Success teams to streamline sales strategies and market positioning.

  • Stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and evolving customer needs to identify new opportunities.

What we're looking for

  • 1-2 years of experience in sales or in tech, banking, consulting, PE/VC or similar.

  • Proven success in generating leads, qualifying prospects, and managing high-volume outreach campaigns.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, able to quickly build rapport and articulate the value of Heidi’s AI-driven healthcare solutions.

  • Highly organised, disciplined, and results-oriented with a strong problem-solving ability and the ability to prioritise multiple tasks simultaneously.

  • Comfortable working independently in a dynamic, fast-paced startup environment with a high degree of accountability.

  • Eager to learn, adaptable, and excited about professional growth opportunities.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

description:
You'll ship agents that move money, and you'll keep the rhythm that gets them shipped. Accounts payable, accounts receivable, treasury: autonomous agents that read the invoice, match it, negotiate the discount, release the payment, and reconcile the cash. Every one of those actions runs in production with a customer's CFO watching the result.

Most of what the industry calls engineering culture was written for a world where humans typed every line. That world ended. We want to build the 2026 version: engineers who work with agents as a matter of course, where the unit of work is the loop (spec, generate, evaluate, correct, ship) rather than the ticket, where code review means reviewing the evals and prompts as hard as the diff, and where a regression suite over real customer invoices is what lets us move fast on systems that touch money. Nobody has a settled playbook for this. You'll help write ours, from inside a pod.

This is a player-coach role. You'll spend most of your week shipping code in one of our pods, and you'll manage the engineers day to day: 1:1s, feedback, growth, the hard conversation when it's needed. The rest goes to the delivery rhythm: pods commit to milestones in Linear, post progress daily, and review misses every Friday with the Head of Product and the CTO. You run that review and the follow-ups. The management share grows as we go from 8 engineers to 16 and beyond; this role is the natural path to Head of Engineering. You'll report to the CTO. Causa Prima is built by the team behind Taulia and backed by Creandum.

What you'll do

  • Ship as a senior engineer, 70 to 80% of your week. Take the hardest work in your pod, unblock the integration nobody wants, and review the code that touches money personally. You set the bar by clearing it in front of the team.

  • Manage the engineers day to day. Weekly 1:1s, direct feedback, growth plans, and the honest conversation about who's ready for more scope and who's in the wrong seat. The CTO owns hiring decisions and the technical direction; the people in the pods are yours.

  • Run the delivery rhythm. Weekly milestone commitments, the Friday review, the dashboard of committed versus delivered, and the follow-ups when something slips. Misses are discussed to learn, not to blame; your job is that they get discussed at all, with an owner and a next step.

  • Make the loop the way we work. Specs written so an agent can execute them, evals that run before merge, review practices that treat prompts as code. The CTO owns the architecture; you own that every pod actually works this way, including the change management when they don't.

  • Raise risk early. You know on Tuesday what won't make Friday, and so does everyone who needs to.

  • Sit with customers. Controllers explaining why the agent's match was technically correct and operationally wrong. AP leads walking you through an SAP extension nobody documented. That's where the next milestone comes from.

What we're looking for

  • A senior engineer who likes the operational side. You've shipped production systems where mistakes cost money: fintech, payments, ERP-adjacent, enterprise B2B. You've also managed engineers, run their 1:1s and a delivery cadence, and liked it enough to want more of it while still writing code.

  • You build with agents. You've shipped something in the last month using an agentic coding tool that saved you a week, and you can show us. Python or TypeScript in anger, and enough PostgreSQL to review a migration without asking.

  • You've kept commitments reliable before, with numbers. Committed versus shipped, cycle time, whatever you tracked. You've followed up on slipped work without it turning into a blame exercise.

  • Minimal process instincts. You add a ritual when it earns its place and remove it when it doesn't. A weekly review that takes 30 minutes, not 90.

  • You can disagree with a founder and stay in the room. We hire for trust and challenge in that order.

  • Fluent English. German or Spanish is a plus. Munich preferred, Madrid works. You'll be in both offices regularly.

This is a wishlist, not a checklist. If the role excites you but you don't tick every box, we would encourage you to apply anyway.

Nice to have

  • Depth in purchase-to-pay or order-to-cash, or scar tissue from an SAP integration.

  • You've grown with a team through a Series A or B.

  • Former founder or founding engineer.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
Staff Engineer

You'll be the most senior engineer on the agents that run finance operations for our customers — designing, building, and operating the autonomous agents that handle accounts payable and receivable end-to-end. From invoice validation and dispute resolution to cross-company negotiation and cash optimization.

This is an individual-contributor role at the top of our ladder: no direct reports, full technical authority over the architecture the rest of the team builds on.

What you'll do

  • Agent architecture — Design the multi-agent system: agent boundaries, event contracts, orchestration patterns, and the separation between LLM reasoning and deterministic enforcement. LLMs inform; rules enforce. You own where that line sits for every action that moves money, and the authorization gateway that makes it non-negotiable.

  • Agentic dispute resolution — An agent that reads the claim, gathers the evidence from the PO, contract, and delivery record, forms a position, and works it to settlement — negotiating with the counterparty where that's appropriate, escalating to a human where it isn't. Deductions and short pays classified, tied to the underlying claim, and driven to resolution rather than parked in an aging bucket.

  • Agentic dynamic discounting — Agents that continuously price early payment against the cash position on both sides of the transaction, propose terms, and execute them. Static payment terms become a negotiation that runs on its own.

  • Matching and reconciliation — Three-way matching across purchase order, goods receipt, and invoice with configurable tolerances; cash application against bank statements and remittance advices, including partial payments and residuals; the exception paths that follow when any of it fails. Unglamorous but important: The foundation everything agentic sits on.

  • Validation & anomaly detection — Business rule checks, duplicate and near-duplicate detection, pricing discrepancy detection, and anomaly detection across time. Precision matters as much as recall here: a false positive is a blocked supplier and an angry procurement lead.

  • Integration framework — ERP systems first and deepest, then banking APIs, accounting platforms, Gmail, Drive, and Slack. Auth model, credential lifecycle, data normalization. Today each connector is a project; you make the next one a configuration.

  • Compliance & security — Agents operate within a zero-trust model. You'll design how agents verify independently against source data, how outbound content is reviewed, and how the system prevents cascading failures from prompt injection. Plus the European e-invoicing mandates now landing across France, Germany, and Spain, and what EN 16931 means for the pipeline.

  • Platform & data infrastructure — Own the primitives every agent action rests on: an append-only PostgreSQL event store with tamper-evident hash chaining for replay and audit; cryptographic signature verification on agent events and approval chains before anything external fires; the Workflow Constraint Engine that gates payments, emails, and API calls on deterministic policy, not model output; row-level multi-tenancy and tenant-scoped credentials across every data store; attribute-based authorization via Cerbos, evaluated the same way whether the caller is an agent or a human; and the MCP security layer — auth, capability-scoping, rate limiting — for external agent-to-agent access.

  • The engineering standard — Architecture decision records, review bar, on-call, and a clear view of what we deliberately don't build. You'll write the things the next ten engineers read in week one, and you'll spend time with controllers and AP leads watching agents fail in ways no test predicted.

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years shipping production systems; currently Staff, Principal, Lead IC, or a founding engineer. You've carried an architecture through a scaling step and lived with your own decisions.

  • Strong systems design thinking — agent boundaries, failure modes, trust boundaries, contract evolution. Money movement is not retry-safe by default and you already know why.

  • Depth in Python and/or TypeScript in production, and deep PostgreSQL: event sourcing, row-level security, indexing tradeoffs, schema evolution under load.

  • Hands-on experience with LLM-powered systems, agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or similar), and document AI (LlamaIndex, LlamaParse, or similar).

  • Strong opinions about when to use an LLM vs. a rules engine vs. traditional ML — and the courage to defend them.

  • Experience designing data pipelines, integration architectures, or event-driven systems in production.

  • Security awareness — you think about what happens when untrusted input meets your pipeline, and about segregation of duties before someone makes you.

  • Technical leadership without a title: reviews that teach, designs that get adopted, engineers who get faster because you're there.

  • Effective use of AI coding tools with strong review skills for LLM integration and auth code.

  • Domain knowledge across the purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash cycle. You don't need all three areas below, but you need real depth in one and working fluency in the rest — enough that when a controller describes an exception, you understand it before they finish:

    • Accounts payable — PO and non-PO invoice intake, coding to GL account and cost centre, approval routing and delegation of authority, three-way matching and tolerance handling, blocked-invoice and exception workflows, duplicate detection, payment runs, payment terms and early-payment discounts, supplier master data and bank-detail verification, period-end accruals for un-invoiced receipts.

    • Accounts receivable — invoice issuance and e-invoicing, cash application and remittance matching, partial payments, short pays and residuals, credit memos, deductions and dispute handling, dunning and collections strategy, credit limits and credit risk, aging and DSO.

    • Procurement — requisition to purchase order, supplier onboarding and qualification, catalogues and contract pricing, goods receipt, off-contract and maverick spend, sourcing and supplier negotiation, and the handoff into AP where most of the pain actually lives.

  • Fluency with the systems this runs on: ERPs (NetSuite, Dynamics, or the SMB stack), the sub-ledger to general-ledger relationship, and how period close constrains what an agent is allowed to do and when.

Nice to have:

  • Peppol and EN 16931 in production, or bank connectivity via ISO 20022.

  • Cryptographic primitives in production: digital signatures, hash chaining, tamper-evident logs.

  • SOC 2, GDPR, or data-residency engineering in a regulated environment.

  • You've founded something, or have been employee 1 to 5 in a startup.

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Own a specific geographical region or country within the EMEA market which includes target-accounts and an existing book of business that has companies with 3000+ employees. Primary focus is on hunting new business opportunities, building sales pipeline, and driving growth within the ENT sector. Upscaling existing account base through expansion and upsell, leveraging our Extended Access Management Identity.

 

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

 

Expectations of this role

This is a remote opportunity within the UK.


You will also regularly engage in customer-facing activities, including in-person meetings, events, and other travel required to effectively support your territory. Travel within your assigned territory, and occasionally outside of it, will be a part of your job, and you are responsible for managing your schedule in a way that works for the company and you.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

 

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of SaaS sales experience, preferably in security with a focus on Enterprise accounts OR top performance in MidMarket/Commercial and ready to step up.

  • Proven Enterprise AE success; Southern Europe enterprise selling experience; cybersecurity or identity background; evidence of personally creating and closing complex enterprise opportunities.

  • Experience building an immature/whitespace territory; CISO and senior security buyer relationships; strong new-logo hunting record; experience balancing strategic deals with volume; MEDDPICC or comparable enterprise sales methodology.

  • (EMEA) Demonstrated success in owning and growing a geographical territory or country within EMEA.

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and KPIs.

  • Outstanding sales skills in prospecting, pipeline building, strategic account planning, value-based selling, and territory management, with meticulous operating rigor in pipeline management, forecasting, and pacing to target

  • Demonstrated success in upselling & cross-selling to both new customers and across a book of business, and in uncovering customer pain points beyond what's initially shared

  • Proficient skills in business acumen, negotiation, relationship building, communication & presentation skills to C-Suite

  • Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate complex cybersecurity concepts, particularly in Identity and Access Management.

  • Self-motivated, driven, and able to work independently in a remote setting.

  • Preferable proficiency with Salesforce, Slack, Zoom, Linkedin Sales Navigator & Outreach

 

Nice to have:

  • Existing channel relationships; Middle East and Africa experience; Italian and/or Spanish language capability.

 

Please note that this job description is subject to modifications and is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities.

 

What you can expect:

  • Own Your Territory: Manage and grow your designated geographical region or country within EMEA, focusing on acquiring new ENT clients and expanding existing accounts.

  • Manage Pipeline: Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through proactive prospecting (cold calling, and networking), supplemented with inbound leads and effective pipeline development inline with our sales methodology.

  • Drive New Business Growth: Key Activities for effective sales strategies to meet and exceed sales targets including:

    • Strategic Territory Segmentation: Refine client targeting by segmenting against Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) that align with enterprise needs and priorities.

    • Contextual Business Understanding & Multithreading: Develop deep insights into the enterprise's structure, key decision-makers, and buying processes. Implement multithreading to engage various stakeholders across departments, ensuring broad influence and deeper engagement.

    • Excellence in Outbound & Pipeline Generation: Leverage a combination of self-generated outreach, BDR collaboration, and marketing-driven initiatives to consistently build a high-quality pipeline.

    • Tailored Discovery & Scoping: Align 1Password’s value to the enterprise's unique challenges through comprehensive discovery and scoping, ensuring that proposed solutions are relevant and impactful at scale.

    • Continuous Improvement via Coaching: Maintain a growth mindset by actively participating in high-quality coaching sessions, driving incremental improvements in sales performance weekly

  • Drive Organic Growth: Identify opportunities to expand and cross-sell 1Password’s solutions within existing accounts by building key stakeholder relationships and leveraging your understanding of Extended Access Management.

  • Engage the Industry: Attend industry events, trade shows, and conferences to represent 1Password, build brand presence and build relationships with potential customers

  • Stay Informed: Stay up to date on cybersecurity trends and developments, particularly in Identity and Access Management, to provide valuable insights to clients and position 1Password as an industry leader.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally:

    • Internal Collaboration: Foster strong partnerships with internal teams such as BDR, Solutions, Channels, Onboarding, and Customer Success to craft tailored solutions that address the complex needs of enterprise clients, ensuring alignment across the customer journey.

    • Multithreaded Client Engagement: Develop and maintain relationships across multiple stakeholders within enterprise client organizations, including C-level, IT, and security teams. This approach ensures a comprehensive understanding of the client's business, enhancing account health and expanding long-term value.

  • Focus on Solution-Driven Selling:

    • Implement 1Password methodology to ensure our solutions are strategically aligned with client goals and tailored to their specific needs.

    • Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of client challenges, and position our offerings as impactful, customized solutions that drive value and outcomes.

  • Present and Negotiate:

    • Confidently present to executives, articulating the value proposition of our products and services.

    • Create mutual action plans to align the sales team and prospects on responsibilities, steps and timelines for closing deals.

    • Utilize effective negotiation skills to drive mutually beneficial outcomes.

 

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £87,000 GBP and £126,000 GBP, and is commission-eligible. This role is also immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

 

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future

Community

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

title: Senior Product Manager (Retail Media)
description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE OPPORTUNITY

Millions of people come to Carwow when they are ready to change their car. That is some of the highest-intent automotive audience in the UK, and it makes Carwow one of the most valuable places for dealers and manufacturers to reach buyers at the moment of decision. Retail media is how we turn that intent into revenue, for our partners and for the business.

We have built the foundations: sponsored placements across the buying journey, a growing media and audience offering, and commercial products for dealers and manufacturers. Demand is ahead of what we can currently serve. If we can make our advertising products smarter, more relevant and easier to buy, we grow revenue for partners while keeping the experience useful for the consumer. That balance is the job.

This role is the product voice for retail media: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with engineering, design, data and commercial teams to build it.

This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Advertisers want smarter targeting, better recommendations on where to spend, and proof of what worked. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise.

If you know retail media inside out, want to shape a fast-growing revenue line, and build things with a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Set the product direction for Carwow's retail media products, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery with advertisers and internal teams: interviews, campaign data and marketplace analysis, to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value

    • Identify and test opportunities to bring AI into our advertising products: smarter targeting, relevancy and recommendations that actually change results Work in partnership with the Technical Engineering Manager and Designer, and collaborate with the engineers in your team, to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives revenue, advertiser performance and consumer relevance, not just activity

  • Technical & Data Partnership:

    • Work closely with engineers on how ads are served, targeted, priced and measured, and make sound trade-offs between build, buy and integrate

    • Own measurement: run controlled tests so every new placement or format proves its revenue impact without harming the consumer experience

    • Use data directly, interrogating campaign and marketplace performance to guide decisions

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, commercial, campaign operations and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Support the commercial team in partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Proven retail media experience is a prerequisite: you have built or owned sponsored ads, onsite media or audience products at a marketplace, retailer or ad tech business, and you know how the industry works

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with evidence of growing advertising revenue or advertiser performance

  • Technically strong: you understand ad serving, targeting, auction and pricing mechanics, APIs and tracking, and can hold a credible conversation with engineers about architecture and trade-offs

  • Comfortable with data: you interrogate performance data yourself, design your own tests, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for analysis to land in your inbox

  • Great stakeholder skills: you build trust with commercial teams, technical partners, advertisers and senior leaders, push back when needed, and come with solutions rather than problems

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in automotive, marketplace or two-sided products

  • Hands-on use ofAI tools in your own work, and experience shipping AI-powered features

  • Experience with ad serving platforms, offsite media or CRM monetisation Experience taking new products to market, including pricing, GTM planning and launch

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Step 1: Talent Screening Call (30 min)

  • Step 2: Hiring Manager Call: Experience (45 min)

  • Step 3: Case Study (60 min + Task)

  • Step 4: Values Interview (45 min)

 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

    • 28 days annual leave

    • 1 day for your wedding

    • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

    • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

  • A genuinely unsolved problem — the constraint here is people and adoption, not model capability.

  • High agency. We set outcomes, not playbooks. You and your team define how this evolves.

  • Real commercial breadth. This team sits at the intersection of Product, go-to-market, and eligibility — closer to the customer than most engineering roles.

  • Craft that's respected, not traded off. Strict typing, layered testing, ADRs, observability — and AI-native ways of working as the baseline, not an experiment.

  • A company mid-transformation, told straight. Multiverse is rebuilding itself into a product-powered, AI-native company in real time. You're not inheriting a finished system — you're one of the people defining it.

What you'll do

You will own delivery, technical direction, and team health in the D&P service estate — the full learner and customer journey from diagnosis through prescription to onboarding and growth tracking. Concretely, that means leading the team(s) across surfaces like:

  • Diagnosis & needs assessment — AI-heavy services (retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM-scored assessment) that turn raw signal into a picture of where a learner or employer actually is.

  • Prescription & eligibility — build the product which helps learners and customers understand the best learning course for their skills and career development, that leverages a customer's levy funds. Much of this is load-bearing logic with a genuine financial and regulatory blast radius.

  • Recommendation & onboarding — turning a diagnosis into the right prescribed path and getting learners into it, where those decisions become visible to customers and learners.

  • The platform arc — continuing to carve D&P logic out of the shared legacy monolith into dedicated services, while backing the newer AI-native product from beta toward scale.

  • Coach and build the team. Hire well, give every report a real growth plan, and move the team into a high-performing, AI-native operating rhythm — promotions and performance issues are never a surprise.

  • Stay hands-on. Whiteboard distributed designs, review and negotiate the RabbitMQ event schemas and API contracts that ripple across services, and write production code yourself when it's the fastest way to de-risk or unblock.

  • Deliver predictably. Use cycle time, change failure rate, and MTTR to balance shipping speed, debt, and change-safety on logic with genuine financial and regulatory blast radius.

  • Raise the AI-native bar. Prove better discovery-to-build-to-review loops on your own team and share what works across engineering.

  • Partner on strategy. Work directly with Product and Design — and closely with go-to-market — to turn learner and customer behaviour into technical direction on the surfaces where eligibility and recommendation decisions become visible to real customers.

What we need

A few terms you'll see below: D&P (Diagnose & Prescribe, this team's name), BAM (our hiring framework — Behaviour, Achievement, Mastery), ADRs (architecture decision records), IfATE (the UK body governing apprenticeship standards).

  • Engineering management of full-stack teams shipping production software, with real technical depth to review architecture and challenge design.

  • A team you led has shipped AI features to real users and operated them — not a side experiment.

  • Strong Python/TypeScript (if you don’t have Typescript, you will need to learn): React/Next.js (App Router, RSC, server actions), tRPC/GraphQL, Node/Express.

  • PostgreSQL at scale via an ORM, with migration discipline on large, live schemas.

  • Event-driven systems on a message bus (we use RabbitMQ) — versioned events, idempotency, backward-compatible migration.

  • A high engineering maturity bar as second nature: typing, testing, feature flags, ADRs, CI/CD, observability.

  • AI-native delivery in practice — you build daily with Claude Code, Cursor, or the current best tool, and understand context management, model selection, tool design, and the token economics that separate a prototype from an affordable production system.

What sets you apart

  • GTM/acquisition-funnel experience — you've owned surfaces where onboarding and eligibility meet real customers.

  • Strangler-pattern pragmatism — legacy monolith and greenfield edge-native product, at the same time.

  • Accessibility and UX as defaults on learner-facing surfaces, not afterthoughts.

Not for you if

This role won't fit if you'd rather run ceremonies than stay in the system, the design, and the code yourself. It also won't fit if you see AI tooling as a productivity tweak rather than a step change in how a team works. And it needs someone who renegotiates the scope out loud when it's wrong, not someone who absorbs it and hopes it works out.

Stack & how we lead

TypeScript core (React/Next.js, Node) with PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ as the event backbone, plus Python and Elixir services — from RAG pipelines to a Claude-powered edge-native product. GitHub, CircleCI, Datadog. AI-assisted development is first-class, not bolted on.

You'll lead full-stack engineers (with Python/Elixir specialists), report to the Senior Director of Engineering for Diagnose & Prescribe, and calibrate regularly with a peer group of EMs — you're not doing this alone. We reject micro-management: we set the objective, you and your team own the how. Kindness, candour, and curiosity over hierarchy — bad news travels as fast as good.

Quelques repères :

Notre ambition est assumée : devenir un actionnaire qui pèse au conseil des entreprises qui freinent la transition. Nous commencerons une fois le cap du milliard d'euros d'épargne franchi. Entre nos 150 M€ et ce milliard, il y a ton travail.

Le poste

Tu prends en main toute l'acquisition B2C haut de funnel de Green-Got : faire venir de nouvelles personnes sur notre app, et les amener à ouvrir un compte ou à investir.

Tu as deux grands objectifs : les ouvertures de compte (compte + carte de paiement) et la collecte (investissement). Notre north star, c'est l'ARR : ce qui compte, c'est ce que tu rapportes vraiment à la boîte, pas le nombre de clics.

Tu ne pars pas de zéro. Nos canaux existent et tournent déjà. Ton job : les reprendre, les améliorer, les scaler, et en inventer de nouveaux. Le budget que tu pilotes se compte en centaines de milliers d'euros.

On cherche un doeur, pas un stratège qui délègue. Tu mets les mains dans le cambouis, tu testes, tu shippes, et tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi lancer.

  • Acquisition payante : Google Ads, Meta et autres réseaux sociaux. Ciblage, créas, landing, tests, optimisation, toujours pilotés par le chiffre d'affaires final.

  • Nouveaux leviers : tu imagines et testes des canaux auxquels personne n'a encore pensé.

Une personne, des agents IA

Pendant des années, une règle a joué contre nous : pour rivaliser avec une banque, il fallait ses effectifs, ses agences et ses milliards. Cette règle vient de tomber.

L'intelligence artificielle ne récompense pas la taille. Elle récompense les organisations alignées, rapides et capables de décider. C'est l'asymétrie du renard, et pour la première fois elle joue pour nous : elle nous permet d'avoir dans dix ans l'impact que nous devions avoir dans cent. Pendant ce temps, les quatre grandes banques françaises portent 260 milliards d'euros d'actifs fossiles, et chaque mois que nous perdons est un mois qu'elles gagnent.

C'est pourquoi tu seras une personne autonome, épaulée par un agent IA pour chaque canal (site, GEO, affiliation, ads…). Notre stack est très moderne, car nous n'avons pas d'autre choix que de nous décupler pour peser.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 
 
 

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

 

En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme.

Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base clients qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

 
 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et l'équipe Support. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques.

 
 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

 

3 premiers mois :

- Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

 

4 à 6 mois :

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes de ton portefeuille client.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix et l’usage du client et partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

 

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration

- Tu prends le contrôle et mènes au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser

 
 

Profil recherché

 

- Expérience de plusieurs années au sein d’une “néo-banque”, d’une banque en ligne ou d’une banque traditionnelle.

- Excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

- Expérience précédente en support B2B requise.

- À l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

- Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus avec notamment la connaissance des produits des Fintech actuelles du marché.

 

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacements à Paris au sein de nos locaux par mois (frais pris en charge).

 
 

Process de recrutement

 

- Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo - Senior Recruiter (30 min)

- Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert - Responsable de l’équipe (1h)

- Dernier échange visio avec Johan Chrzanosvski - Head of Customer Care, et Maxime Leclercq - Head of Financial Services (45 min)

 
 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto.
